latest_release.name: Dewey Bravo 9.3.1
latest_release.body:
# Download ## Setup Guide https://www.shipofharkinian.com/setup-guide ## Changes Relatively quiet patch release from 9.3.0 release feedback. Fixed typos, couple crashes, couple logic gaps, & cleaned up UX around wincon revamp. Last of which is particularly important for races ## What's Changed
* Fix name of Fire Trial silver rupee by @f1ana in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7328 * Unfreeze Link on forced text skip by @f1ana in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7338 * Show message when no Linux file picker is found by @f1ana in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7339 * Prevent crash when fairy spawn is unknown by @f1ana in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7340 * Win condition tooltip + altar hint + draw full triforce for anywhere wincon by @A-Green-Spoon in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7341 * Allow skipping Mweep cutscene in progress by @JordanLongstaff in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7349 * Fix typos in randomizer by @f1ana in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7357 * Add TCG keys to item tracker by @serprex in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7361 * [Bugfix] Restore Ganondorf Lights Hint by @f1ana in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7363 * Fix missing open chest logic in Jabu MQ by @serprex in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7368 * Add function to customequipment to fix shooting gallery by @Jepvid in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7370 * Fix anchor issues by @serprex in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7362 * Fix extracting from MQ rom padded to 64MB by @serprex in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7376 * Pin latest libultraship's port-maintenance branch (develop-dewey) by @bassdr in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7379 * [Bugfix] Use game encoding for name in save editor by @f1ana in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7383 * stop timer upon lifting triforce, not upon warping to credits by @serprex in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7385 * Fix OOB check in audio_seqplayer.c by @serprex in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7387 * Bombchu Bowling ammo changeable during minigame by @JordanLongstaff in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7350 * Fix logic errors due to unused regions by @serprex in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7396 * Try to fix windows builds by @Pepper0ni in https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Shipwright/pull/7397 * Fix defeating Ganon when wincon is not Defeat Ganon warping outside Hy
